code_label: Quantum computers expected to outperform classical computers
text_span: Within this decade, quantum computers are predicted to outperform conventional computers in terms of processing power
rationale: States the motivating claim about quantum advantage.

code_label: Financial sector expected to benefit early
text_span: It is predicted that the financial sector would be one of the first to benefit from quantum computing
rationale: Frames finance as an early application area.

code_label: Hybrid QNNs used for continuous variable prediction
text_span: we use Hybrid Quantum Neural networks to present a quantum machine learning approach for Continuous variable prediction.
rationale: Summarizes the paper’s main research aim.

code_label: QNNs as variational quantum circuits
text_span: Quantum neural networks are variational quantum circuits that store quantum information in continuous degrees of freedom
rationale: Defines the model class used in the paper.

code_label: Hybrid approach suitable for NISQ era
text_span: This hybrid approach is much less demanding in terms of number of qubits and the number of layers required in the quantum circuit hence this hybrid approach is much more suitable for NISQ era
rationale: Justifies the hybrid design choice.

code_label: QNNs can be used as machine learning models
text_span: there has been a lot of research on the use of PQC as machine learning models, also commonly termed as Quantum Neural Network
rationale: Positions PQCs as ML models in the study.

code_label: Three-stage QNN architecture
text_span: typical structure of QNNs can be broadly broken into three stages: feature encoding, processing and measurement with potential post-processing
rationale: Describes the general architecture adopted.

code_label: Feature encoding maps classical data to quantum state
text_span: Encode the feature vector x to n-qubits by using a unitary transformation
rationale: Specifies the first step of the QNN pipeline.

code_label: Circuit parameters optimized to minimize loss
text_span: we will need to adjust the parameters ...θn to minimize some loss function
rationale: States the training objective for the model.

code_label: Basis encoding is simple but limited
text_span: For low depth circuits qubit encoding is suitable, But the state resulting from qubit encoding is very simple mathematically, which might limit the expressive power of the model.
rationale: Identifies a limitation of basis encoding.

code_label: Angle encoding creates more complex feature maps
text_span: Angle encoding produces much more complex feature maps which can be made more complex by repeating the encoding process multiple times.
rationale: Describes a feature-encoding choice and its effect.

code_label: Angle encoding is computationally expensive
text_span: However, angle encoding is also much more computationally expensive
rationale: States a cost drawback of angle encoding.

code_label: Amplitude encoding uses logarithmically many qubits
text_span: only log2(n) qubits are needed to encode n features thus an enormous amount of information can be encoded with each qubit added.
rationale: Highlights a key advantage of amplitude encoding.

code_label: Amplitude state preparation is inefficient
text_span: However, there is not much efficient way of preparing the state.
rationale: States a practical limitation of amplitude encoding.

code_label: Barren plateaus cause vanishing gradients
text_span: the variance of the expected value of randomly initialized PQCs vanish exponentially with increasing number of qubits & circuit depth.
rationale: Identifies a training difficulty for PQCs.

code_label: Loss landscapes become extremely flat
text_span: loss landscapes that are extremely flat in most of parameter space, hence the name Barren Plateaus
rationale: Describes the consequence of barren plateaus.

code_label: Expressibility measured by KL divergence to Haar states
text_span: lower the KL divergence higher is the Expressability of the circuit.
rationale: Defines the expressibility metric used to assess circuits.

code_label: Entangling capability estimated by Meyer-Wallach measure
text_span: the entangling capability(Ent) can be estimated by sampling the circuit parameters and calculating the average of the MW measure Q of output states
rationale: Defines the entanglement assessment method.

code_label: Finance problems include classically intractable cases
text_span: there are still a lot of cases where classical computation techniques turn out to be inadequate for example NP-hard problems like portfolio optimization
rationale: Motivates quantum methods for finance.

code_label: Asset pricing use case selected
text_span: For this study we chose asset pricing use case wherein we use QML techniques to predict property prices.
rationale: States the specific application studied.

code_label: PennyLane supports hybrid quantum-classical models
text_span: It Supports hybrid quantum and classical models allowing users to connect quantum hardware with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Qiskit, Cirq etc..
rationale: Explains the software framework used for implementation.

code_label: Strawberry Fields simulates continuous-variable circuits
text_span: Strawberry Fields allows to Construct and simulate continuous-variable quantum photonic circuits.
rationale: Identifies the CV quantum software used.

code_label: TensorFlow Quantum provides high-level QNN abstractions
text_span: It provides high-level abstractions for the design and training of QNNs including discriminative and generative quantum models
rationale: Describes another framework used in the work.

code_label: Boston Housing dataset used for training
text_span: We use Boston Housing Data
rationale: Specifies the dataset used in experiments.

code_label: Dataset has 506 samples and 13 features
text_span: Data Samples contain 13 feature variables of houses at different locations around the Boston suburbs in the late 1970s.
rationale: Gives the dataset size and feature count.

code_label: Data standardized before modeling
text_span: We standardize the data by scaling it and removing the mean and variance
rationale: States a preprocessing decision.

code_label: PCA reduced features to nine components
text_span: to get at-least 95% of variance explained we need 9 principal components.
rationale: Explains dimensionality reduction and feature selection.

code_label: AngleEmbedding chosen over AmplitudeEmbedding
text_span: AngleEmbedding chosen over AmplitutedEmbedding because the dataset is fairly large with 500+ samples and so is the number of features
rationale: States a key modeling choice and justification.

code_label: StronglyEntanglingLayers used for QNN layer
text_span: For QNN layer StronglyEntanglingLayers template is used
rationale: Specifies the quantum ansatz used.

code_label: Hybrid model sandwiched between classical layers
text_span: The Complete neural network model has the quantum circuit layer sandwiched between the input and output classical NN layers
rationale: Describes the hybrid architecture.

code_label: Mean squared error used as loss
text_span: Since linear regression is the problem at hand, selected loss type is mean squared error MSE
rationale: States the training loss function.

code_label: Classical baseline kept similar for fair comparison
text_span: Most of the architecture & parameters have been kept same as the Hybrid-QNN for fair comparison
rationale: Explains the baseline design choice.

code_label: Photonic QNN uses displacement encoding and CV layers
text_span: DisplacementEmbedding Encodes N features into the displacement amplitudes r or phases Φ of M modes(qubits), where N ≤M.
rationale: Specifies the photonic model’s encoding method.

code_label: Photonic CV neural net uses interferometers and Kerr nonlinearity
text_span: The layer consists of interferometers, displacement and squeezing gates mimicking the linear transformation of a neural network
rationale: Describes the photonic QNN layer structure.

code_label: Photonic model limited to three features
text_span: the Photonic QNN is using only three features
rationale: States a constraint in the experiment setup.

code_label: Photonic simulation memory scales poorly
text_span: the memory required for simulation scales like DN, for D dimensions and N wires/qubits.
rationale: Identifies a computational limitation.

code_label: Photonic model failed at higher feature counts
text_span: At 6 features the model error-ed out giving out of memory and at 5 features the model went on training for over 10 hours and then timed out
rationale: Reports a concrete experimental limitation.

code_label: Photonic QNN did not learn much
text_span: as expected the model pretty much did not learn anything.
rationale: Summarizes the poor outcome of the photonic experiment.

code_label: Hybrid QNN slightly outperformed classical NN
text_span: First Quantum Neural network model performs slightly better than the simple classical neural network with the same settings & conﬁgurations
rationale: Reports the main comparative result.

code_label: Hybrid QNN took longer to train
text_span: it took about three times the time to train compared to the classical NN
rationale: Reports a performance tradeoff.

code_label: QNN generalization appeared better
text_span: the QNN is already performing slightly better, this could further be tweaked explored by using diﬀerent settings like encodings or diﬀerent ansatz.
rationale: Notes observed generalization and possible improvement directions.

code_label: Photonic QNN near comparable but simple
text_span: the Photonic QNN is also able to perform with near comparable performance demonstrating similar loss decay
rationale: Reports the photonic model’s observed behavior.

code_label: Hybrid QNN predictions were close to actual prices
text_span: the model has generalized fairly well and the predicted prices are having closer variability to the predicted prices
rationale: Describes the qualitative fit of the hybrid model.

code_label: Classical NN generalized less well
text_span: the model has not generalized as well as the Hybrid-QNN model
rationale: Compares the classical baseline unfavorably.

code_label: Photonic QNN learned nothing in practice
text_span: the model has not learnt anything at all
rationale: States the negative result for the photonic model.

code_label: Higher-end quantum devices could improve CVQNNs
text_span: with the availability of higher end quantum devices this CVQNN architecture could be improved far more.
rationale: Indicates a future research direction.

code_label: Future work on photonic CV QNN ansatz
text_span: As Future Research, diﬀerent photonic CV QNN ansatz & approaches can be explored
rationale: States a proposed next step.

code_label: Borealis enables better experiments
text_span: Now with cloud availability of Xanadu’s Borealis much better experiments can be tried.
rationale: Points to a future experimental platform.
